install_notes: Windows: Install Gpg4win from https://gpg4win.org/ | Linux: sudo apt install gnupg | macOS: brew install gnupg
usage_notes: After install, run: gpg --gen-key (for test identity only, NOT company identity)
non_claims: GPG optional — NOT required for V3.3
Do NOT generate company/organization GPG keys for this RC
Test keys only, NOT production identity
fingerprint_present=true does NOT mean production-ready identity
No private key material is collected or stored
